title: Self-heal, in-app update, upstream and SDK update checks, standalone start

checks.what: A damaged store is moved aside (two in one second keep both), never deleted
Restore from the last-good copy; the copy is 0600 whatever the umask
A held run lock or fresh index.lock is left alone
Clearing a stale owner note cannot erase a live run's note
Unattended heal is refused whatever DLP_CHECK_SELF_HEAL_AUTO_APPLY says
interval_minutes and _ts oracle tables
Only git pull --ff-only; the branch is an allowlist before git runs (option-looking names refused)
A fork or mirror is never reported as verified
Fetch and pull timeouts and git vanishing are plain errors
GitHub answers that are not JSON, not objects or not hex
Tokens and URL credentials never in update results
local_settings.bat is 0600
The relauncher cannot be changed by the folder name
The standalone edition never updates or restarts itself
Loopback, token gate on, read-only, pinned token and container flag dropped, from env and from the settings file
-c text other than the regex worker and unknown options are refused
BOM, non-UTF-8 and oversized settings files
ZSCALER_PORT oracle and the 65535 boundary
Every upstream request goes to an allowlisted https host (existing SSRF suite plus the online run)
Response size cap, with the boundary at the cap
Bad JSON and wrong shapes from PyPI and the registry
Version strings from PyPI never become paths
Wheel hash checked; zip bomb and damaged wheel refused
The per-user data folder is 0700 even when it already existed; a linked old folder is not followed
report_self_heal.html escapes every tenant-derived string (E())

findings.title: update() raised on a git pull timeout or when git vanished mid-update, so POST /api/app/update answered 500
findings.fix: update() wraps the run; a pull timeout is a step error and set-aside edits are re-applied

findings.title: github_branch_head() raised on a GitHub answer that was not JSON or not an object, returned a non-hex 'sha', and put an unvalidated branch into the URL
findings.fix: branch checked with valid_branch(); the sha must be hex; any bad answer is (None, reason)

findings.title: verify_against_github_api() raised on a non-string sha and matched an empty local commit as verified
findings.fix: sha parsed by _api_sha(); an empty local commit never matches (fail closed)

findings.title: local_settings.bat, which receives ZSCALER_CLIENT_SECRET when settings are moved out of a start script, was created with the umask (0644)
findings.fix: written through safe_files.private_open (0600, an existing file narrowed)

findings.title: The POSIX relauncher put the app folder into sh -c script text, so a folder named with $( ), ` or a quote ran commands on restart
findings.fix: the folder and paths are passed as sh positional arguments ($1..$4)

findings.title: recover_unmerged() read conflicted paths without -z, so a non-ASCII file name came back quoted, was not copied aside, and was reset
findings.fix: git diff --name-only -z

findings.title: git error text shown in update results could quote a credentialed remote URL (older git)
findings.fix: _err() redacts URL user-info

findings.title: _safe_get() read every answer whole into memory with no size cap
findings.fix: streamed and capped at MAX_BODY_BYTES (64 MB); a larger or larger-declared body is refused

findings.title: The update check's network diagnostics and fetch errors echoed proxy URLs with user:password (HTTPS_PROXY, http_proxy, ZSCALER_UPDATE_PROXY)
findings.fix: redact_url_credentials() on every proxy value and error message

findings.title: An update cache that was not a JSON object (or had a non-object entry) turned every source into an internal error
findings.fix: _load_cache() keeps only object entries

findings.title: _check_pypi() raised on a PyPI answer in the wrong shape
findings.fix: shape checked; status error with plain words

findings.title: An existing per-user data folder (an older version's, or the old name moved into place) kept 0755; in the standalone edition it holds the UI token, profiles and the audit log
findings.fix: data_dir() narrows an owned, non-link folder to 0700

findings.title: download_sdk() used a version string from PyPI's answer as a URL segment and as the extraction folder (../ escaped the work folder)
findings.fix: valid_version() (PEP 440 characters only) before any request or path; malformed release keys ignored

findings.title: download_sdk() unpacked a wheel with no cap on members or unpacked size
findings.fix: MAX_WHEEL_MEMBERS and MAX_WHEEL_UNPACKED checked before extractall

findings.title: pypi_releases(), registry_latest() and download_sdk() raised on JSON of another shape, deep nesting or a damaged wheel
findings.fix: shape checks; (None, reason) results

findings.title: The standalone edition crashed at start with a traceback on a local_settings.env that is not UTF-8 (UTF-16 from Notepad) and glued a UTF-8 BOM to the first key
findings.fix: read as utf-8-sig; a file that is not text is skipped

findings.title: local_settings.env was read whole with no size cap
findings.fix: MAX_SETTINGS_BYTES (256 KB); larger files are ignored

findings.title: check_locks() cleared a stale owner note by truncating the file by name after the check, erasing the note of a run that took the lock in between
findings.fix: _clear_owner_note_if_free() truncates only while holding the flock

findings.title: check_locks() removes a run lock that is still flock-held when the PID in its note is not alive here (a holder in another PID namespace sharing the data folder would lose its lock)
findings.fix: kept: the designed case is an orphaned fd inherited by a child of a crashed run, pinned by tests/test_self_heal.py::test_stale_run_lock_whose_owner_is_gone_is_released; the container and a local install do not share a data folder by default

findings.title: The updater installs requirements.lock from the pulled tree; a package without a wheel would be built from its hashed sdist
findings.fix: kept: --require-hashes --no-deps pins every artifact by SHA-256, and the pulled tree is the code the app runs next anyway; --only-binary would break platforms without wheels

findings.title: check_permissions() follows symbolic links when it narrows a store's mode
findings.fix: kept: the targets live in the 0700 data folder and only files owned by this user are changed
